_comment: Run modifiers for Signal Lost. Player picks 1 of 3 random modifiers at run start.

double_resources.name: Surplus Supply
double_resources.description: Start with 2x resources, but lose 1 tower slot.

glass_cannon.name: Glass Cannon
glass_cannon.description: All towers deal +50% damage, but core has half HP.

speed_demons.name: Speed Demons
speed_demons.description: Enemies move 30% faster, but drop 50% more resources.

iron_core.name: Iron Core
iron_core.description: Core has +10 HP, but towers cost 25% more.

signal_boost.name: Signal Boost
signal_boost.description: Towers have +20% range, but enemies have +15% HP.

chain_reaction.name: Chain Reaction
chain_reaction.description: All chain effects get +2 jumps, but chain damage falls off 20% faster.

deep_freeze.name: Deep Freeze
deep_freeze.description: Freeze effects last 2x longer, but Cryo Nodes cost 2x.

data_mining.name: Data Mining
data_mining.description: +3 transmissions decoded per run, but waves have +1 elite enemy each.

overclocked.name: Overclocked
overclocked.description: Towers attack 40% faster, but have a 5% chance to malfunction each shot.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.description: Core has only 5 HP. All towers deal 2x damage. Ultimate risk/reward.
